definitions.explanation: A person or business that installs and repairs water pipes, faucets, and plumbing fixtures.

examples.japanese: {水道屋|すいどうや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んだ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
⟦{水漏|みずも}れ→水漏れ：07936_mizumore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{水道屋|すいどうや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: The water leak was bad, so I asked a plumber to fix it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水道屋|すいどうや}さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{蛇口|じゃぐち}→蛇口：04218_jaguchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}したら→依頼する：21376_irai⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: When I asked the neighborhood plumber to replace the faucet, they came right away.

notes:
An everyday word for a plumber or plumbing service. Composed of ⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧ (water supply, plumbing) + ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shop, dealer, person in a trade). The suffix ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ is commonly used for tradespeople and shops.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水道屋|すいどうや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to call a plumber
- {水道屋|すいどうや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to ask a plumber
- {水道屋|すいどうや}さん: plumber (polite, with さん)

THE ～{屋|や} PATTERN:
Many tradespeople and shops use this suffix:
- {電気屋|でんきや}: electrician; electronics store
- ⟦{大工|だいく}→大工：04051_daiku⟧: carpenter (does not use ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧)
- ⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: gas company/worker
- ⟦{引越|ひっこ}し→引越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: moving company

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{配管工|はいかんこう}→配管工：07090_haikankou⟧: plumber — more formal/technical term for the tradesperson
- ⟦{水道工事|すいどうこうじ}→水道工事：26588_suidoukouji⟧: plumbing work — refers to the work itself
- ⟦{水道局|すいどうきょく}→水道局：27580_suidoukyoku⟧: water department — the municipal water authority
